title: Dissecting Immune Determinants in Lesional Skin of Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma During Mogamulizumab Therapy.
snippet: : Mycosis fungoides (MF) and Sézary syndrome (SS) are the predominant cutaneous T-cell lymphomas. Although malignant T cells in MF/SS overexpress CCR4 and respond to the anti-CCR4 antibody mogamulizumab, skin response rates vary. title: A Three-Gene Prognostic Signature Driven by an ER Stress-Associated ceRNA Network: Integrating Single-Cell Transcriptomics and Cross-Platform Validation in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
